title: Late-Handling Addition to Northgate Protect Accident Plan Cancellation Refunds
content:
**Customer-facing term.** A late-handling addition raises the cancellation refund of a Northgate Protect Accident-tier plan where the plan holder's most recent cancellation request on the plan that is still submitted, neither confirmed nor withdrawn, was recorded some days before today: the slow-handling rate of 10 percent at 30 days or more, the late-handling rate of 5 percent at 7 days or more but fewer than 30 days, and nothing for fewer days or no such request.

The days are calendar days from the date the request was recorded to today. The rate raises the refund by that percentage of it.

| Most recent still-submitted cancellation request recorded | Refund raised by |
|---|---|
| 30 days or more before today | 10 percent |
| 7 to 29 days before today | 5 percent |
| 0 to 6 days before today | Nothing |
| No such request (none, or all confirmed or withdrawn) | Nothing |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical days)

- 30 days: 10 percent; 29 days: 5 percent.
- 7 days: 5 percent; 6 days: nothing.
